lead.headline: Tankers Hit by Mines in Strait of Hormuz
lead.summary: Two oil tankers struck naval mines, exploded and caught fire while using an unauthorized route through the strait, Iran's Revolutionary Guard said.

sources: Sources: AP  •  Reuters  •  Just Security  •  Open Chronicle  •  Principia  —  Real reporting, 25 Nov 2026

stories.headline: Houthis Strike Saudi Oil Refinery
stories.summary: Yemen's Houthis say they hit the Ras Tanura refinery; a day earlier, a drone attack on a Riyadh tower injured 11 people.

stories.headline: Israel Kills Hamas Security Chief
stories.summary: Hamas colonel Mohammad Abuelouf was killed with his wife and two children, Gaza officials said.

stories.headline: Kyiv's Drones Set Two Russian Refineries Ablaze
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones hit Rosneft's Syzran and Kuibyshev refineries overnight; Russia struck Odesa and Kyiv in reply.

stories.headline: Asian Stocks Plunge; Dow Tops 50,000
stories.summary: South Korea's KOSPI fell 6.16% and the Nikkei 2.78%; the Dow closed above 50,000 for the first time.

stories.headline: Huawei Convicted in US Court
stories.summary: A Brooklyn jury found Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts, including bank fraud and stealing trade secrets.

stories.headline: Australia Signs Security Treaty with Solomons
stories.summary: Canberra and Honiara signed a treaty barring any foreign military base on Solomon Islands.
